home_question: Hello and welcome to the Home page. Keep your finger pressed on a button to hear me explain what it does.
home_desc_document: Document. Tap to read a letter or prescription.
home_desc_contacts: Contacts. Tap to call your family and friends.
home_desc_health: Health. Tap for your medications and medical appointments.
home_desc_map: Map. Tap to find help near you.
home_desc_understand: Ask. Tap to ask me a question out loud, or photograph a paper to have it read to you.
home_desc_call: Call. Tap to call your family and friends.
home_desc_findhelp: Find help. Tap to see help locations near you.
home_desc_urgence: Emergency. Tap to call the emergency services: Ambulance, Police or Firefighters.
sos_desc: Emergency. Tap to call the emergency services.
understand_tts_intro: Hello. Here you can take a photo of a paper, a letter or a prescription, or ask me a question. I answer you out loud.
understand_desc_mode_photo: A paper to read. Tap to photograph a letter or a prescription.
understand_desc_mode_question: Ask a question. Tap to speak to me or type a question.
understand_desc_choose_file: Choose a file. Pick a document already on the phone, an image or a PDF.
understand_disclaimer: ⚠️ This is an automatic answer. For your health, ask a doctor for advice.
voice_desc_mic: Microphone. Tap, ask your question out loud, then release. I answer.
voice_not_understood: I didn't quite understand. Tap again and speak.
voice_no_permission: The microphone is not allowed. Check your phone settings.
emergency_tts_intro: Emergency screen. Tap a large button to call: Ambulance for a health problem, Police for danger, or Firefighters for a fire or an accident.
emergency_choose: Who do you want to call?
emergency_desc_close: Close. Return to the previous screen without calling.
contacts_tts_intro: You are on the Contacts page. Here, you can call your loved ones or send them a photo. Just click on the call button.
contacts_desc_open_settings: Tap to allow access to contacts.
contacts_desc_call_by_voice: Tap, say the name of the person to call, I place the call.
contacts_say_who_to_call: Say the name of the person to call.
contacts_call_not_found: I couldn't find that contact. Try again.
document_tts_intro: Hello and welcome to the Document page. Here, you can take a picture of a letter or prescription. I will be happy to read and explain it clearly to you.
document_desc_take_photo: Camera. Take a picture of your document.
document_desc_gallery: Gallery. Choose a picture already in your phone.
document_desc_new_photo: Start over. Take a new picture.
document_no_text: I do not see any text on this picture.
document_loading_label: Please wait, I am reading the document.
document_desc_back: Back. Return to the previous screen.
document_scanner_tts_intro: You are on the camera screen. Place your document flat inside the frame shown on the screen, then press the large round button at the bottom to take the photo.
document_scanner_instruction: Place the document in the frame
document_scanner_desc_back: Back. Cancel and return to the previous screen.
document_scanner_desc_capture: Take the photo. Photograph the document placed in the frame.
document_scanner_permission_text: The app needs the camera to take pictures of your documents.
document_scanner_desc_allow: Allow the camera so you can take a photo.
health_desc_cancel_med: Cancel. Close without adding a medication.
health_desc_cancel_appt: Cancel. Close without adding an appointment.
health_notif_med: It's time to take your medication.
health_tts_intro: Hello and welcome to the Health page. Here, you can save your medical appointments and medications. This way, I can kindly remind you when it's time.
notif_med_tts: Hello, it is time to take {{name}}.
help_tts_intro: Hello and welcome to the Help page. Here, you can ask me any question out loud by touching the screen, or call emergencies directly using the buttons at the bottom.
help_disclaimer: ⚠️ This is an automatic response. Consult a doctor for your health.
map_tts_intro: Hello and welcome to the Map page. Here, you can discover help and support locations near you, and I can guide you there with the GPS.
map_desc_close_place: Close. Go back to the map.
contacts_desc_voice: Add a contact by speaking. Tap to start.
contacts_voice_listening: I'm listening. Say the name, then the phone number.
contacts_voice_no_permission: Microphone access is not allowed. Check your phone settings.
contacts_voice_result_tts: I understood: {{name}}, number {{phone}}. Please check and save.
contacts_voice_not_understood: I didn't quite understand. Try again or fill it in by hand.
contacts_desc_cancel_add: Cancel. Close without adding a contact.
contacts_desc_cancel_import: Cancel. Close the list without choosing a contact.
contacts_desc_cancel_voice: Cancel. Stop adding a contact by voice.
health_desc_voice_add: Tap, I ask about the medication question by question. You answer out loud.
health_voice_ask_name: What is the name of the medication?
health_voice_ask_duration: For how many days? Say a number, or say: I don't know.
health_voice_review: It's ready. Check it, then tap Save.
health_desc_voice_appt: Tap, I ask about the appointment question by question. You answer out loud.
health_voice_ask_day: Which day? For example: tomorrow, or Monday, or March the twelfth.
health_voice_ask_time: At what time? For example: two p m, or half past nine.
document_too_slow: It is taking too long. Try again with a clearer photo, or a smaller file.
